name: Serbia
description: Serbia is a fast-growing study destination in Southeast Europe, known for its affordable tuition, high-quality education, and vibrant student life. With EU-recognized degrees and English-taught programs, Serbia offers international students excellent value and career opportunities in Europe.

universities.name: University of Belgrade
universities.description: The University of Belgrade's Faculty of Medicine is internationally recognized and offers English-taught medical programs with modern clinical training facilities.

universities.name: University of Novi Sad
universities.description: A leading technical university in Serbia with strong engineering programs, modern research facilities, and growing international student community.

universities.name: Metropolitan University Belgrade
universities.description: Specializes in IT and software engineering programs with strong industry connections and modern curriculum aligned with EU standards.

universities.name: University of Niš
universities.description: The University of Niš Faculty of Medicine offers accredited medical programs with English-medium instruction and modern clinical training at the University Clinical Centre.
